create_glfw_window: create a GlfwWindow instance with a given width, height, and title for rendering
run_event_loop: run the GlfwWindow event loop with a tick function that renders each frame
toggle_fullscreen: toggle the GlfwWindow between full-screen mode and its previous windowed size
handle_keyboard_input: handle keyboard input events via GlfwKeyboard and register callbacks on the on_key observable
handle_mouse_input: handle mouse input events via GlfwMouse including move, click, double click, and scroll
